description: Resolve an ordered request descriptor against a hierarchical rate-limit configuration, exercising boundary paths: a key-only default match, an intermediate node carrying no limit, a nested default beneath a value-qualified parent, a request whose first entry matches no value and no default, a descriptor that runs past a leaf with extra entries, resolution against an unknown domain, and an intermediate node that both carries a limit and owns deeper descriptors.

configs.name: config.yaml
configs.content:
domain: d
descriptors:
  - key: a
    rate_limit:
      unit: second
      requests_per_unit: 1
  - key: b
    value: v
    descriptors:
      - key: c
        rate_limit:
          unit: minute
          requests_per_unit: 2
  - key: e
    value: ev
    rate_limit:
      unit: hour
      requests_per_unit: 3
    descriptors:
      - key: f
        rate_limit:
          unit: day
          requests_per_unit: 4

cases.expected_output:
matched=true
full_key=d.a
requests_per_unit=1
unit=SECOND
unlimited=false
shadow_mode=false
